title: Honeyed Peruvian Tofu Bowl
description: A silky, monsoon-inspired bowl of air‑fried tofu, quinoa, and crisp veggies glazed in honey and Peruvian spices, Jain-friendly and vegan.
instructions: Press the tofu to remove excess moisture, then pat dry with a towel.
In a bowl, whisk honey, soy sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame oil to make the glaze.
Coat tofu cubes with the glaze, reserving a small amount for later.
Preheat the air fryer to 200°C (392°F) and lightly spray the basket with palm oil.
Air‑fry the tofu in a single layer for 15 minutes, shaking halfway, until golden and crisp.
Meanwhile, cook quinoa in 2 cups of water for 15 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
Steam sweet potato cubes and snow peas for 5 minutes, keeping them crisp.
Combine cooked quinoa, sweet potato, snow peas, and bell pepper in a bowl; drizzle with remaining glaze and toss gently.
Top the quinoa mix with the air‑fried tofu, garnish with scallion slivers, and serve hot.
